text:
arjun: FYI - noticed a weird egress in tenant fairness after yesterday's quota-normalizer rollout. looks like thresholds got 'smeared' across regions and some small tenants lost headroom. anyone dug in yet?

emily: saw the spike on per-tenant plots. looks like region_multiplier was applied twice in one codepath. small but dramatic. :grimacing:

noah: double-application? ouch. sounds like config layering bug between ingress filter and mapping service.

ajun: (typo) arjun: ha. supposed to be 'arjun' :)

julia: quick question - is this only affecting admission-time quota, or also background quota reconciliation?

emily: admission-time for sure. reconciliation job actually fixed some of the drift later at midnight, but too late for customers.

noah: root cause theory: we introduced "region_bias" in the new mapper and then the edge shaper also applied a region scaling for legacy reasons. two independent tweaks with no idempotency.

arjun: proposal: introduce an explicit signal provenance tag in the quota token: {"source":"mapper|shaper|probe","value":...} so we can assert single-writer semantics before combining.

julia: agree. Also want to add a small prober that runs synthetic requests to check effective quota per-tenant post-merge. canary test idea: every 10m run 5 probes per-region per-tenant-sample.

emily: replay infra can simulate the merged behavior. @replay-bot can you run a 72h multi-region replay with region-bias toggled on/off and output per-tenant delta table?

replay-bot: replay-bot: queued job #8273: 72h-multi-region-run. expected finish ~1762242600. output to /replays/8273/deltas.csv when done.

noah: operational mitigation while devs fix: add a temporary override in config service that sets region_multiplier=1 for affected tenants. that needs a fast rollback path though.

arjun: +1. also emitting a metric "quota.merge.count" with labels: source_provenance and applied_flag so we can detect double-applies instantly.

julia: long-term: define an ownership boundary doc: mapper owns logical score, shaper owns runtime shaping but must consult mapping-service for region adjustments. must codify in README and add integration test asserting single application.

emily: can we add a linter in CI that flags configs that define region_multiplier in both services? we have good infra for config validations.

noah: risk: probes could be noisy if we pick unlucky tenants. choose low-traffic synthetic tenant IDs and mark them as probes so billing/alerts ignore them.

arjun: draft patch plan: 1) quick rollback override for region_multiplier 2) add provenance tag in quota token + metric 3) replay + canary 10% capacity 4) CI linter + integration test 5) postmortem and runbook update. who picks up each step?

emily: I'll own 1 & 5. will make override and update runbook.

julia: I'll own 2 & 4. will PR provenance and CI linter.

noah: I'll own 3 (replay + canary). will coordinate with ops for canary window.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created canary group 'quota-probe-canary' at 1762239050. Monitoring hooks added (p95 latency, throttle_rate, effective_quota).

arjun: thanks. timeline? aiming to finish rollback + metrics within 2h, provenance + linter by tomorrow EOD, then canary.

emily: rolling override now: config set region_multiplier=1 for tenant-set 'small-affected' -> applied 1762239060.

replay-bot: replay-bot: job #8273 started 1762239075. will post deltas on completion.

noah: heads up - let's also avoid coupling mapping changes to model retrains. if detector scale changes, mapping must be tolerant (e.g., normalized by historical quantiles).

arjun: good call. add to the postmortem checklist: "mapping resilience to model rescale".

julia: adding note: example provenance token format in mapping-service: ```
{"provenance":"mapper","raw_score":0.64,"region_adjust":1.0,"normalized":0.64}
```

emily: thanks all. will ping customers impacted and include timeline in support ticket.

arjun: wrap-up: quick rollback done, canary created, owners assigned. sync 3pm for follow-up and postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
